headline: Beakon transport and power worker
title: Beakon | Top Transport And Power | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a strong hauler in Palworld one point zero? Beakon is an Electric bird Pal that works Transporting level five, Generating Electricity level four and Gathering level two. That makes it a great helper for a busy base. Its alpha version is a level thirty seven boss you can catch. Will you put Beakon on your power plant? Comment below!
description: Beakon in Palworld 1.0 is an Electric Pal with Transporting level five, Electricity level four and Gathering level two.
joke: Beakon sparks a joke about power bills.
